name: @pipeworx/mcp-football-data

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: List competitions accessible on your plan — Premier League (PL), Championship (ELC), Primera División/La Liga (PD), Serie A (SA), Bundesliga (BL1), Ligue 1 (FL1), Eredivisie (DED), Primeira Liga (PPL), Campeonato Brasileiro Série A / Brasileirão (BSA), Copa Libertadores (CLI), UEFA Champions League (CL), European Championship (EC), FIFA World Cup (WC). Use the returned `code` for downstream calls. Each entry includes `current_matchday` for its live season.

tools.name: get_competition_matches
tools.description: Fixtures and results for a competition — Premier League, Championship, Primera División/La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Brasileirão, Copa Libertadores, UEFA Champions League, European Championship, or the World Cup (see `competition` codes below). Filter by status (SCHEDULED, LIVE, IN_PLAY, PAUSED, FINISHED, POSTPONED, SUSPENDED, CANCELLED), date range, matchday, stage, or season year. "Next round" / "upcoming fixtures" questions: pass no `status` or `status: "SCHEDULED"`, not a matchday number, unless the caller already knows which matchday number it is.

competition.description: Competition code (e.g., "PL" = Premier League, "PD" = La Liga, "CL" = Champions League)

status.description: Match status filter (SCHEDULED | LIVE | IN_PLAY | PAUSED | FINISHED | POSTPONED | SUSPENDED | CANCELLED)

tools.name: get_competition_standings
tools.description: League table / standings for a competition season — Premier League, Championship, Primera División/La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Brasileirão, Copa Libertadores, UEFA Champions League, European Championship, or the World Cup. Returns total / home / away tables.

matchday.description: Standings as of a specific matchday (optional)

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Team detail by ID — current squad, coach, competitions, venue.

tools.name: get_team_matches
tools.description: A team's matches across competitions. Filter by status, date range, competitions, season, or venue.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-football-data forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the football-data pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
